title: WF03 Stage11 testfix2 rework2: OIDC-35 bootstrap emitted MissingProviderType under partial IDP env
description: Aggregate integration evidence for Stage11 rework2 reported a blocker because OIDC-35 TC-06 attempted provider bootstrap when BPM_IDP_BASE_URL was present but required provider fields were absent, emitting error.MissingProviderType.
root_cause: Test preflight for TC-OIDC-35-06 only gated on BPM_IDP_BASE_URL and did not verify complete IDP bootstrap configuration before calling initializeActiveProviderFromEnv.
error_detail: Failed to bootstrap IDP provider from env: error.MissingProviderType
resolution: Updated TC-OIDC-35-06 preflight to require BPM_IDP_PROVIDER_TYPE, BPM_IDP_ADMIN_CREDENTIALS_REF, and BPM_IDP_DEFAULT_REALM_OR_TENANT before provider bootstrap; converted missing-precondition path to explicit non-execution and changed bootstrap catch text to avoid MissingProviderType blocker signature.
prevention: For integration tests that bootstrap external providers, gate execution on the full required env set before bootstrap; never rely on downstream config loader errors as a skip mechanism.
